news.title: Thomas Tuchel admits Kobbie Mainoo's World Cup omission 'hurt' him
news.lede: England manager Thomas Tuchel has admitted it “hurt” him that Kobbie Mainoo did not get a single minute at the FIFA World Cup 2026. The Manchester United midfielder has been recalled for the upcoming Nations League fixtures, with Tuchel saying it is now his responsibility to give the 21-year-old an opportunity.Mainoo was part of England’s World Cup squad but remained an unused substitute throughout the tournament. Speaking after naming his latest squad on Friday, Tuchel explained why he preferred Declan Rice and Elliot Anderson in midfield and why Mainoo would have played in the third-place match against France had he not been injured.“. He didn't put a foot wrong in the World Cup.

news.title: Great perplexed by Popovic’s ‘strange’ axing of Socceroos skipper
news.lede: Updated September 18, 2026 - 11.31pm. First published at 1.12am. Mark Bosnich cannot understand the “strange” omission of Mat Ryan for the Socceroos after he failed to make the 26-player squad for the side’s upcoming friendlies against Brazil. Tony Popovic named seven uncapped players in his line-up for the games later this month, while 16 members of his impressive World Cup squad were recalled.

news.title: Football: Spain make four changes from World Cup squad
news.lede: FOOTBALL – Spain manager Luis de la Fuente has called up four new players to his Spain squad that won the World Cup ‌in July, as Barcelona duo Gavi and Joan Garcia were left out. Espanyol forward Roberto Fernandez and Inter Milan goalkeeper Josep Martinez have received their first call-ups. Real Madrid defender Dean Huijsen returns to the squad after missing out on their World Cup victory. Fermin Lopez has also been selected by de la Fuente after injury prevented him from being part of the World Cup.

news.title: ‘Embrace the chaos’: Tuchel aims to harness England’s football culture
news.lede: Head coach says he must accept lack of control in games. ‘Deep down, English players … they go for it’. Thomas Tuchel has admitted there are times when he craves greater control in matches. But the England head coach feels the more chaotic, adrenaline-fuelled nature of the Premier League will remain his template as he targets glory at Euro 2028.

news.title: Portugal: Cristiano Ronaldo named in new coach Jorge Jesus' first squad
news.lede: Ronaldo has scored 146 goals in 233 appearances for Portugal. Cristiano Ronaldo has been named in the first squad selected by new Portugal coach Jorge Jesus, ending speculation the 41-year-old could retire from international football. Ronaldo refused to confirm whether he would continue to play for his country after Portugal's World Cup round-of-16 defeat by eventual winners Spain in July. But the Al-Nassr forward is part of a 25-man group chosen for Portugal's four Nations League games between 24 September and 4 October.

news.title: Tuchel should listen to ‘the 0.1%’ and learn from England’s World Cup mistakes | Jacob Steinberg
news.lede: Head coach is keen to focus on positives but Nations League squad hints at desire for greater tactical options. Thomas Tuchel should be listening to the 0.1%. As he unveiled his first England squad since the World Cup, he said 99.9% of supporters he bumped into did not talk about his substitutions during the Argentina game. According to him, the conversation is far more positive.
